v1.name: V1 readiness
v1.status: Staging runs revealed significant design-quality and owner-intake failures; fixes merged, but no accepted post-fix delivery.
v1.summary: Nov 27: businessbuilder main f1884881f and Stromation main c4a6142e7. Staging Tidy Paws run stopped at S5 ($6.59), a later run scored 5.5/10 with SVG art and missing fonts, and run 5 stopped at planning ($2.98) despite only minor findings. Stromation #378–380 and #382–383 merged fixes for section-loop grading, stock photos, fonts, competitor study, plan gating and checkpoint reuse; #383 reports 482 targeted tests, exact merge-train heavy checks passed, current CodeBuild green. No accepted post-fix site or unattended recovery demonstrated. Businessbuilder #1232 merged tenant/company-scoped intake-record fix after second owner's staging save returned 403 despite starting build; no post-fix journey shown. #1234 merged durable worker jobs and approval retries (98 focused tests, local Postgres checks). #1241 reports e2e9 audit reached minimum but failed final delivery gate; fixes merged without fresh passing replay. #1242 reports five audit settings enabled in prod Nov 27 and staging deploy refused by parity guard; overlay fix merged, redeployment unverified. Latest businessbuilder combined status empty; latest visible full release CI 45684464178 passed Nov 25 on b8bcb0fbf. #1192/#1223 worker intelligence, #1203 truthful paid start and #1206 shared spend guard remain open. No verified complete SaaS, custom agent, paid handoffs, repeatable economics or autonomy denominator. Need durable deployed isolation, successful production rollout, independent 8+/10 site, checkout/forms, revisions, three handoffs and automatic recovery.

SelfOperate receives about 150–500 qualified prospects/visitors over 90 days.
Paid conversion is roughly 1–2% while the product remains supervised.
Supervised delivery capacity remains roughly 2–4 projects per month.
Roughly half to three-quarters of eligible delivered customers retain the $299/month ongoing SelfOperate service after any included period.
